title: Ministers vow to create new welfare system for young people as they back Milburn report
summary_full: Government promises spending cuts to pay for the proposals, described by prime minister as ‘watershed moment’UK politics live – latest updatesNeet ideas: what’s in Milburn’s report?Ministers have promised to create an entirely new welfare system for young people as they gave their backing to Alan Milburn’s 278-page report, promising spending cuts next year to help pay for his proposals and giving him a government role to push them through.Andy Burnham, the prime minister, told his cabinet colleagues on Tuesday morning the report was a “watershed moment” and offered a “comprehensive vision” as he invited its author to address the meeting.
